title: Portfolio, consolidation and operations
subtitle: Thirty-five repositories, six substrates and one person. What can be merged, what has been built twice, where the line runs that must not be crossed — and the system that keeps the whole thing running without falling apart.
scope: The map covers **35 repositories read from beginning to end** — README, documentation, code, workflows and git history. The account holds more than that: at least eleven others are public, not archived and **are not here**, among them `DeepDiveInto_CSharp_Dictionaries_presentation` (3 stars) and `llm-book-mini-project`, which one of the books refers to. A repository reaches the map when someone has actually read it — not when it exists.
